data_status.description: Static analysis of previously collected data. Values are not live prices.

publication_status.notes: Allowlisted portfolio aggregate; raw source data, private orders, and credentials are excluded.

disclaimers: Historical research snapshot of simulated/analytical results; not live data, not investment advice.
Public aggregate only; raw market data and account-level records are excluded.

input_series.name: BTC reference index (reference_price_usd), de-duplicated by reference_timestamp
input_series.type: close-only index levels (last observation per bar); not OHLC
input_series.note: Kalshi contract prices are never used. Historical data; not live.

atr.reason: True OHLC bars are not available; close-only reference levels cannot yield a true range.

vwap.reason: BTC spot trading volume is not available.

volume_indicators.reason: BTC spot trading volume is not available; contract volume is not a substitute.

parameters.rsi_smoothing: Wilder (seed = mean of first window gains/losses, then (prev*(n-1)+x)/n)
parameters.ema_seed: alpha = 2/(window+1), seeded with the SMA of the first window closes
parameters.bar_convention: Right-closed bars labelled by bar end; close = last observation with reference_timestamp <= bar end.

volatility.estimator: RMS of log returns (zero-mean realized volatility), not a demeaned sample standard deviation
volatility.formula: 100 * sqrt(mean(r_i^2)) over the last window log returns, r_i = ln(C_i / C_(i-1)); needs window+1 closes
volatility.annualization: bar value * sqrt(525600 / bar_minutes), assuming 24/7 trading and independent returns; very noisy on this ~12-day sample
volatility.mean_assumption: mean log return assumed zero (not subtracted)

masking_rules: Missing bars have null close and are never forward-filled.
Partial bars (first/last bar not fully covered by observations) are excluded from indicator inputs.
Bars overlapping a collection gap longer than collection_gap_min_seconds are excluded from indicator inputs.
Indicators restart their warm-up after any excluded or missing bar; values before warm-up completes are null.
Indicator values use only data up to each bar's end (no look-ahead).
